greeting: Welcome to the Granite Medicare Part B provider self-service line. This line is fully automated. Representatives are not available on this line.

root.prompt: For claim status, press 1 or say claim status. For eligibility, press 2 or say eligibility.
root.retryPrompt: Sorry. For claim status, press 1. For eligibility, press 2.
root.failText: We are unable to continue. Please call again. Goodbye.

npi.prompt: Enter the ten digit provider N P I, followed by the pound key.
npi.invalidText: That N P I is not valid.

ptan.prompt: Enter the six character P TAN. The P TAN begins with a letter. For letters, press the number key repeatedly until you reach the letter: for example, for the letter C, press 2 three times. Pause between characters. In this simulator, type the letter w for a pause.
ptan.invalidText: That P TAN does not match our records format. Remember to pause between characters.
ptan.failText: We cannot verify the provider. Goodbye.

tin.prompt: Enter the nine digit tax identification number.
tin.invalidText: That tax I D is not valid.

dos.prompt: Enter the eight digit date of service, month, day, year.
dos.invalidText: That is not a valid date.

status.template: No claim on file for date of service {dos}.

variants.06152026: One claim on file for date of service {dos}, N P I {npi}, P TAN {ptan}. Claim status: finalized. Paid amount: one thousand two hundred forty dollars and ten cents. Payment date: the fourth of this month. Check number: nine nine zero one one. Remark code: none.
variants.07012026: One claim on file for date of service {dos}, N P I {npi}, P TAN {ptan}. Claim status: denied. Reason code: C O dash one six. Claim lacks information needed for adjudication. A remittance advice was mailed. Appeal rights apply.
variants.*: No claim on file for date of service {dos}. Please verify the date and try again.

again.prompt: For another date of service, press 1. To repeat this status, press 2. To end this call, press 3.
again.retryPrompt: I did not recognize that entry. This menu accepts a single key only. To check ANOTHER date of service, first press 1, then enter the date when prompted. To repeat the last status, press 2. To end the call, press 3.

goodbye.prompt: Thank you for using Granite Medicare self service. Goodbye.
